purpose: Record controlled live acceptance. Replace unknown values only after observing the run.

same-flow-failure-recovery.notes: Demonstrate one flow failing and then recovering; verify one incident resolves against that same flow.

notification-failure-retry.notes: Force Teams create/update failure, then retry; verify persisted Pending/Failed state and no failure-count increment on retry.

replay-60.notes: Replay 60 failures and record scanner and per-child durations, cursor outcome, incident count, and notification results.

backlog-over-900.notes: Exercise a backlog greater than 900 including failures 1-900, success 901, failure 902; verify recovery waits until drain.

overlong-run-id.notes: Verify a run ID over the storage limit reports an environment error, preserves its cursor, and does not block other environments.

child-duration-under-120s.notes: Measure slowest synchronous incident-child duration under representative load; record sample size and maximum.

coverage-and-heartbeat-routing.notes: Verify enabled inventory source coverage, scanner routing, and missing/stale heartbeat behavior for applicable sources. Then set desired_scanner_states with MON-FailureScan and MON-FailureScan-Dataverse mapped to observed desired statecodes (0=Stopped, 1=Started).

owner-and-run-links.notes: Verify incident card owner and run links for created and updated incidents.
